settings_inventory_impacts: No inventory rows added, removed, or re-rooted; concept consumes PMInventoryData as-is.
Family fixture rows (memory.half-life etc.) are concept-local demo rows rendered with the same row grammar; they are not inventory ids and are labeled as simulated in receipts.
settings_schema_impacts: Legacy inventory scope arrays include 'global'; this concept renders Project-only semantics (receipts say 'this Project only') and proposes schema work to drop or reinterpret the global scope token — see plan-owner-delta.md.
wiring_impacts: See candidate-wiring-delta.json; every control traces UI→command→owner→validation→mutation→event/receipt→projection→attribution→recovery; demo state marked simulated.
dry_component_impacts: See candidate-dry-delta.json; shared headless modules consumed from _shared (pm-state2, pm-search2, pm-managers2, pm-copy2, pm-shell2); concept-specific candidates listed.
schema_event_storage_impacts: Receipts and restore points stored per-concept in localStorage key pm.settings-demo2.concept-08-directory-take-3; no cross-concept writes.
ObservableWork ops are in-memory only (state.ops cleared on serialize), matching the headless store contract.
migration_supersession_impacts: Supersedes bloom-modal navigation vocabulary with directory cards; cmd.settings.bloom.open retire/alias flagged in command delta.
No supersession of inventory ids; category→domain mapping is presentational only.
slint_port_impacts: Concept is plain HTML/CSS/JS over shared headless modules; a future Slint port would map d3-card/d3-dest/d3-roster/d3-seccard compositions to components while reusing the same headless stores.
